svg.title: 10 catalog values and coverage
svg.desc: Real NASA Exoplanet Archive snapshot of the first 200 planet names alphabetically among rows with period and radius. Panel A preserves discovery-method categories and logarithmic scales; panel B makes the selected fields and nine missing host-metallicity values visible. This extract is not representative and cannot establish occurrence rates or physical class labels.
